note:
92 -> 42, and none of the 50 is this change: the gate has been failing the FALLING way at HEAD, which is the second time in this baseline history.

Measured 42 in a `git archive` tree at HEAD as well as in the workspace, so the repayment is committed and it is not another sessions uncommitted work. `--count` at HEAD reads 42 against a committed floor of 92; the ratchet is exact, so that is a build failure, and it stays one for everyone who runs the gate until the floor is banked.

The previous note recorded the same shape and drew the same conclusion: "the other 35 came down before this change and were never banked -- HEAD measured 110 against a floor of 145 on a clean worktree, so the gate had been failing the falling way for anyone who ran it. Banking both together because an exact ratchet cannot express `mine only`." Here there is no `mine` at all -- this change touches `odoo/` and nothing that writes an order line -- so the floor is banked alone, at the measured value, with the attribution left open.

No `measured_at` recorded which tree the 92 described, so the 50 cannot be attributed to a commit either. What can be said is that the tree measures 42 today and that the number is only allowed to fall.
